meta.title: Legacy structure metrics on all existing runs (Phase 1 audit)

definitions.power: grokverse.analysis.fourier.embedding_power_spectrum: cos_k^2 + sin_k^2 summed over d_model, k = 1..(p-1)/2, constant mode excluded from the denominator
definitions.topK: sum of the K largest power[k] / sum of all power[k]
definitions.n_freqs_for_threshold_90: dominant_frequencies(threshold=0.9): smallest K with cumulative fraction >= 0.9 (uncapped); cap_binding = (K > max_k=8)
definitions.spectral_entropy.normalized: -sum q_k log q_k / log(56), q_k = power_k / sum power
definitions.collisions_j2to7: pairs (k, j), j in 2..7, k in the selected fundamentals, with alias(j*k) equal to ANOTHER selected fundamental
definitions.index_sets: the odd (j=3,5,7) and even (j=2,4,6) aliased index sets that harmonic_shape sums over, after removing the fundamentals; odd_and_even_overlap = indices counted in BOTH shares

square_noise0.0_attribution.denominator: sum of power at the 8 fundamentals (same as harmonic_shape)

closed_form.formula: |X[m]|^2 = 4 sin^2(pi m L/p) / sin^2(pi m/p), L = number of +1 samples

even_p_contrast_fft.note: numpy rfft, not the project basis; balanced runs of 56/56
